ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 92% of the visible ventral area, with low-intensity black pixels localized to the narrow margin of the trailing edge boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Single contiguous high-intensity light-gray/white region covering the entire ventral surface; a continuous, narrow, low-intensity dark band tracks the geometric path of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch with an approximate internal angle of 115 degrees and a relative pixel depth of approximately 1/10th of the fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular micro-serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels; serration frequency is highest on the distal one-third of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a moderate S-curve sweep, characterized by a concave trajectory originating at the median notch and transitioning to a slight convexity before reaching the tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a low-intensity, thickened irregular deformity at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe, contrasting with the more tapered profile of the right tip.
